title: Observation (API v1)
description: One value of a series with its source. Used inside year and all files, and as the body of /v1/<series>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json and /v1/<series>/<YYYY-MM>.json (together with the series fields).

date.description: What the date means depends on the series: see date_meaning in /v1/index.json. YYYY-MM for monthly series.

value.description: Number written with the exact decimal text published.

valid_to.description: Step series (minimum wages, UMA): last day the value was in force; null while it is in force.

term_days.description: TIIE only: the term stated in the DOF note when it differs from the nominal one because the maturity fell on a holiday (for example 29 days for the 28-day TIIE).

origin.description: Where the number was read: sidof (SIDOF indicator API, which mirrors the DOF), dof (the text of the DOF note), inegi (INEGI open data) or derived (computed by this project).

checked.description: True when the value was compared with the text of its DOF note and matched.
